fields.help_en:
The comparison operator for the critical-level alert threshold. Valid values:

GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold: greater than or equal to the threshold. 
GreaterThanThreshold: greater than the threshold. 
LessThanOrEqualToThreshold: less than or equal to the threshold. 
LessThanThreshold: less than the threshold. 
NotEqualToThreshold: not equal to the threshold. 
GreaterThanYesterday: greater than the metric value at the same time yesterday. 
LessThanYesterday: less than the metric value at the same time yesterday. 
GreaterThanLastWeek: greater than the metric value at the same time last week. 
LessThanLastWeek: less than the metric value at the same time last week. 
GreaterThanLastPeriod: greater than the metric value in the previous period. 
LessThanLastPeriod: less than the metric value in the previous period. 

Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

You must specify at least one of the following alert levels: Critical, Warn, and Info. The Statistics, ComparisonOperator, Threshold, and Times parameters must be specified at the same time for the specified alert level
fields.help_zh:
紧急级别阈值比较符。取值：

GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold：大于等于。 
GreaterThanThreshold：大于。 
LessThanOrEqualToThreshold：小于等于。 
LessThanThreshold：小于。 
NotEqualToThreshold：不等于。 
GreaterThanYesterday：同比昨天时间上涨。 
LessThanYesterday：同比昨天时间下降。 
GreaterThanLastWeek：同比上周同一时间上涨。 
LessThanLastWeek：同比上周同一时间下降。 
GreaterThanLastPeriod：环比上周期上涨。 
LessThanLastPeriod：环比上周期下降。 

N的取值范围：1~200。

报警级别Critical（严重）、Warn（警告）或Info（信息）至少设置一个，且该报警级别中的参数Statistics、ComparisonOperator、Threshold和Times必须同时设置
fields.name: escalations_critical_comparison_operator

fields.help_en:
The statistical method for critical-level alerts.

Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

The valid values of this parameter are determined by the `Statistics` column that corresponds to the `MetricName` parameter of the specified Alibaba Cloud service, such as Maximum, Minimum, and Average. For more information about how to obtain the valid values of this parameter, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html.

You must specify at least one of the following alert levels: Critical, Warn, and Info. The Statistics, ComparisonOperator, Threshold, and Times parameters must be specified at the same time for the specified alert level
fields.help_zh:

N的取值范围：1~200。

该参数的取值由指定云产品的`MetricName`对应的`Statistics`列决定，例如：Maximum、Minimum和Average。关于如何获取该参数的取值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/163515.html。

fields.help_en:
The namespace of the Alibaba Cloud service, which is used to distinguish different services. Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

Format: acs_<service name>.

To obtain the namespace of each Alibaba Cloud service, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114916.html operation
fields.help_zh:
云服务的命名空间，用于区分不同服务。N的取值范围：1~200。

命名方式：acs_云服务名称。

调用DescribeProjectMeta接口获取各云服务的命名空间，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114916.html
fields.name: namespace

fields.help_en:
The statistical period of the monitoring data. Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

If you set this parameter to 300, the system collects and aggregates monitoring data every 300 seconds. If monitoring data is reported every minute, the system aggregates the data of 5 minutes, such as the average, maximum, and minimum values. Do not specify this parameter separately because the statistical period may cause unexpected alerts
fields.help_zh:
监控数据的统计周期。N的取值范围：1~200。

设置为300秒，表示每300秒统计一次监控值。如果监控数据每分钟上报一次，则会统计5分钟的值（平均值、最大值、最小值）。因为该统计周期可能会造成非您期望的报警，所以目前不建议您单独设置该参数
fields.name: period

fields.help_en: The name of the alert rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 200
fields.help_zh: 报警规则名称。N的取值范围：1~200
fields.name: rule_name

fields.help_en:
The options for the extended dimension fields. Valid values of N: 1 to 200.

For example, if the alert template is applied to an application group, this parameter is set to `{"disk":"/"}`, and the MetricName parameter is set to `DiskUtilization`, the root partition (`"/"`) of the disks for all instances in the application group is associated with the corresponding alert rule.

For more information about the valid values of the extended dimension fields, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114972.html
fields.help_zh:
Dimension扩展字段的选项。N的取值范围：1~200。

例如：报警模板被应用到了一个应用分组中，当该参数设置为`{"disk":"/"}`，监控项（MetricName）设置为`DiskUtilization`时，表示关联报警模板的应用分组中所有实例的磁盘根分区（`"/"`) 被关联到了对应报警规则中。

关于扩展字段选项的取值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/114972.html
fields.name: selector

fields.help_en: The webhook URL to which a POST request is sent when an alert is triggered
fields.help_zh: 报警发生时回调指定的URL地址。向URL发送POST请求
